description: Twin4Build is a Python package for assembling dynamic building-energy digital twins from connected components. Its maintainers document a Model container, time-step Simulator, ontology Translator, parameter Estimator and operating-point Optimizer. A user provides a semantic building description or manually connected HVAC and space components, measured series for calibration, and a simulation period and step; the package produces component time series and optimisation results. Geography is a user-supplied building, while duration and resolution are set for each run, not fixed by the package. The source is freely available under MIT terms, with pip installation and worked notebooks for simulation, translation, estimation and optimisation. Graphviz is recommended for drawing model graphs, and optional PyTorch routines add installation needs. The published field demonstrations do not show that a fresh building model will be accurate without local component definitions and calibration data. It can support building-operation and digital-twin experiments. The catalogue's model-energyplus is a separate building-energy engine that offers a comparison, but this review did not establish direct interoperability. No building simulation was executed.
